status: Research and offline feasibility only; proposed methods not activated
current_rules: Validated local vision observations cached by source SHA256, model tag and observation version
Label/description lexical matching, synonym aliases and generic-term exclusions
Explicit negative observations defeat contradictory object-list claims
Group/section context alone cannot establish evidence
Numeric/date/system answer generation withheld; absent defects never imply pass
Field types, required answers/photo links, schema locks, permissions and explicit confirmation
Reruns preserve manual/confirmed/rejected placements and review decisions

root_cause.site_identification: Only sign matches among 11 merged label/description terms; procedural wording dilutes support. Structured visible Site ID text is excluded from current retrieval anchors.
root_cause.tower_structure: Tower and ladder match both label subjects but only2/11 merged terms, yielding weak advisory strength.

offline_probe.limitations: Two current positives and three synthetic negatives are a feasibility probe, not a trained or independently validated accuracy benchmark. No rules were activated. No extra image inference or model/library installation.

recommended_methods.method: Published per-checkpoint evidence requirements + subject-first weighted matching
rules: Separate required subjects/synonyms from procedural instructions
Define overview/close-up/readable-label needs and required components
Keep exclusion/negation/contradiction guards; never use group/site alone
Require tower AND ladder for the tower/ladder checkpoint; sign AND explicit identification label for sign identity
Preserve existing published snapshots; introduce any rule schema through a reviewed new template version
Read literal labels, Site/asset IDs and serials with region provenance
Compare only against authoritative assigned identifiers and validated aliases
Multiple code namespaces or conflicting reads remain for review; no invented Site ID
QR payloads are data; do not execute instructions or follow external URLs
Validate English/Arabic labels, digits, unreadable text and O/0 ambiguity
Compare cached observations with checkpoint requirements to retrieve synonym/meaning matches
Use shortlist for candidates, not proof of visibility or engineering compliance
Semantic score is not a calibrated probability; contradictions override ranking
For ambiguous shortlist only, ask existing vision-capable local model for visible support, missing detail, contradictions and source evidence
Use strict structured output with supported/insufficient/contradictory states; abstention valid
No all-checkpoints-per-photo repeated vision loop; use cache and bounded shortlist
Structured JSON validity does not establish factual correctness

recommended_methods.method: Quality, context and engineering rule validation
rules: Check readability, relevant view, crop/occlusion and blur against the specific requested evidence
Use available capture GPS/time only as supporting context; missing facts unknown, development0/0 not valid location
Keep subject relevance, evidence sufficiency and human inspection result separate
Numeric acceptance requires actual measured values, units, approved criteria and appropriate instrument evidence; no photo-only invented measurements
Evaluate a local text-conditioned detector for component-region evidence only if earlier methods insufficient
Bounding boxes aid source review but generic object detection does not validate defects or compliance
Additional model/dependency/hardware cost must be measured on authorized domain photos

acceptance: Use independently labeled holdout originals/sites, similar wrong subjects, wrong-site IDs, contradictory reads, missing/blurred views, multiple valid checkpoints and Arabic/English labels
Report per-checkpoint false links, missed links, precision/recall, ambiguity and abstention; do not treat2photos as accuracy proof
Zero automatic engineering-answer, approval or task-closure writes
Preserve originals and existing manual/confirmed/rejected links and findings across reruns
Benchmark cold400-photo complete pipeline separately from warm cache/rematch; include persistence/retries and final review in any end-to-end30-minute claim
